title: In the family: hospitality, stories and television

blocks.text: Third stage of the stay in Fès. Luca now lives the rhythms of home al-ʿAlawī: lunch with relatives, afternoon tea, evening television, grandparents' stories. It's time to understand the darija of conversation: the names of the family, the past of the most frequent verbs (especially give it to make it, ža "Coming" means the words of the time (ʿad "Just" is, baqi is still" is, dima is always "always," ʿmmṛ "Never before"), and the formulas of hospitality, which in Morocco have an important role: rejecting food is not simple! You will also learn to orient yourself in Moroccan television, where they live together. fuṣḥā (notes), darija (series, talk show), amazigh and french. As always in the MAG track, it's about understanding; production is limited to formulas. Seven weeks, in parallel with B2-22INT-06 and B2-23.

rows: 9–10 hours · seven weeks (weeks 241–247), about 1,5 hours per week in two blocks

blocks.text: Materials This unit, a Moroccan speaker for scripts, standard extracts and Moroccan programs chosen by the tutor
Targets. At the end of the unit you know:
1. understand family names and relations of kinship in darija;
2. understanding the past of the most frequent verbs, including those weak (dar, ža, kla, mša);
3. understand adverbs and expressions of time and appearance (ʿad, baqi, dima, ʿmmṛ, mn bəʿd);
4. respond to the hospitality formulas and politely refuse;
5. follow the broad lines of a scene of a Moroccan series and distinguish television registers.
Seven-week plan (two blocks from 40–45 minutes per week).

Rejecting food. The host insists, please; the guests refuse to accept it. The unwritten rule: you accept the second or third offer, or refuse with a religious formula and a smile (l-ḥamdu li-llāh, šbəʿt) and a compliment to the food. Just say "no," thank you, sounds abrupt.

⁧البارح مشينا عند ختي فالرباط. عاد ولدات بنت، وسميناها ياسمين. ماما فرحانة بزاف، حيت هادي⁩
⁧أول حفيدة ديالها. بقينا تما حتى لليل، وكلينا الحلوة وشربنا أتاي. وغدا إن شاء الله غادي يجيو⁩
